offset_note: 631 up to build 665 (run 34); 630 from run 36 on, because run 35 failed in CI before it published anything; 629 from run 38 on, because run 37 was cancelled before it published anything (run 38 = build 667). Run 39 stamped 668 with offset 629, but that installer was built with an empty release tag, so its manifest URL is the nonexistent tag v0.0.0-dev and the setup aborts with HTTP 404. 628 from run 40 on, so run 40 + 628 = 668 (codename Kolot). Runs 41-44 were test or failed runs and published nothing public. 655 from run 45 on, so run 45 + 655 = 700 (codename Kaporet). Run 45 published 700 Kaporet. Run 46 failed in the Windows unit tests before it published anything, so 654 from run 47 on: run 47 + 654 = 701 (codename Shalem). Run 48 + 654 = 702 (codename Shelishi). Run 49 + 654 = 703 (codename Toledot).
codename_meaning: generations (Biblical Hebrew toledot; Genesis 5:1, zeh sefer toledot adam, this is the book of the generations of man) - a new generation of voices: Levi and Miriam bundled, Natan and Shimon in the default cast
